name: Cross-session messaging
summary: Your Claude Code sessions can send each other messages.
what: One session can find your other sessions and send them a text message, for example to pass on a finding or ask to be told when another session goes idle. It works on the same machine everywhere, and across machines when you're signed in to claude.ai with Remote Control.

impact.title: Hand off work
impact.detail: Tell the session working on an area about a breaking change.

impact.title: Get notified
impact.detail: Ask to hear when another session finishes.

howItWorks: It's on automatically when the requirements are met.
Run /list-agents to see sessions you can reach.
Mention a session with @name in your prompt.
Control incoming messages with crossSessionInbound: accept, hold or refuse.

events.note: First changelog mention of cross-session messaging.
